ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.name: Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the client's point of view.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty-agent/service-provider collateral management transaction from the triparty-agent's/service-provider's point of view.

CounterpartyCollateralTransactionReferen.name: Counterparty Collateral Transaction Reference
CounterpartyCollateralTransactionReferen.definition: Unique collateral transaction reference assigned by counterparty.

CommonTransactionIdentification.name: Common Transaction Identification
CommonTransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification (UTI) agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the exposure.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a Call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a Put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

TerminationOption.name: Termination Option
TerminationOption.definition: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable repo.

BasketIdentificationAndEligibilitySetPro.name: Basket Identification And Eligibility Set Profile
BasketIdentificationAndEligibilitySetPro.definition: Provides information on the baskets identification and the Eligiblity Set Profile.

CollateralParties.name: Collateral Parties
CollateralParties.definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties.

ExecutionRequestedDate.name: Execution Requested Date
ExecutionRequestedDate.definition: Date/time at which the party requested the initiation instruction to be executed.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

ValuationAmounts.name: Valuation Amounts
ValuationAmounts.definition: Provides details on the collateral valuation.

PricingRate.name: Pricing Rate
PricingRate.definition: Interest rate to be paid on the transaction amount, as agreed between the counterparties.

MarginRate.name: Margin Rate
MarginRate.definition: The collateral excess/shortage expressed in the percentage of the collateral required.

SpreadRate.name: Spread Rate
SpreadRate.definition: Margin rate over or under an index.|||||          ||||  ||Feedback

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Specifies the computation method of (accrued) interest of the financial instrument.

AutomaticAllocation.name: Automatic Allocation
AutomaticAllocation.definition: Specifies whether the allocation of the collateral is manual or automatic.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Provides the status of a  transaction.

SecuritiesBalance.name: Securities Balance
SecuritiesBalance.definition: Quantity of securities assigned as collateral position.

CashBalance.name: Cash Balance
CashBalance.definition: Amount of cash assigned as collateral position.

OptionTypePresenceRule.definition: If OptionType is present then TerminationOption is not allowed.

TerminationOptionPresenceRule.definition: If TerminationOption is present then OptionType is not allowed.
